title: Coast Guard searches one, assist another 18 miles northwest of Bahamas after aircraft emergency water landing
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Miami MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew hoists a women who was rescued from an downed airplane Thursday, Dec. 14, 2017 by a good Samaritan seaplane 18 miles northwest of Freeport, Bahamas. The helicopter crew brought the woman to the airport in Freeport where emergency medical services took her to Rand Memorial Hospital. U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Air Station Miami
keywords: MH-65 Dolphin, Air Station Miami, helicopter, Coast Guard, airplane, rescue, USCG, emergency
pass_reason: 30 s of a calm-water basket hoist; the downed plane is never shown, patient taken to hospital
